question: In India which of the following concepts is not used for calculating unemployment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annual status unemployment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The three main measures used for calculating unemployment in India are **Usual Status Unemployment, Weekly Status Unemployment,** and **Daily Status Unemployment.**
 
• **Usual status unemployment** refers to the activity status of a person over a longer reference period, typically a year.
 
• **Weekly status unemployment** identifies individuals who were unable to find work for at least one hour during the reference week.
 
• **Daily status unemployment** captures the activity status of individuals on each day of the reference week.
 
• **Annual status unemployment** is not a recognized or standard concept used by the Government of India for calculating unemployment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unemployment in India:**

 
 
• Unemployment is measured by the **National Statistical Office (NSO)**, under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
 
• The **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)** is the official source for unemployment data in India, introduced in 2017-18.
 
• Unemployment is broadly classified into **open unemployment, disguised unemployment, structural unemployment, and cyclical unemployment.**
 
 
 
• **Usual Principal Status (UPS):**
 
 
• This approach determines the activity status of a person over a longer reference period, typically 365 days preceding the date of the survey.
 
• An individual is considered unemployed if they were not engaged in any economic activity for the major part of the year.
 
 
 
• **Current Weekly Status (CWS):**
 
 
• In this approach, the reference period is the last 7 days preceding the survey.
 
• A person is considered unemployed if they did not work for at least 1 hour on any day during the reference week.
 
 
 
• **Daily Status Unemployment:**
 
 
• Daily status measures unemployment on a day-to-day basis.
 
• This approach provides a detailed and dynamic understanding of employment fluctuations.
